registered: 2026-11-27, before any card was scored (the owner's decisions of 25 and 27 November: five parts weighing equally; pilot on two questions; the 18 inbox items rescored)
unit: a question with two sides; evidence is collected for each side by the same procedure and scored on cards

directness.0: commentary or opinion about what others should do
directness.1: a reported intention, a proposal or a draft
directness.2: an official statement or a published position of the actor itself
directness.3: an action taken or a binding rule in force

power.0: an observer with no hold on the matter
power.1: an influential voice (researcher, commentator, advocacy group)
power.2: an actor who decides part of it (one company, one legislator, a regional body)
power.3: an actor who can decide it (a regulator or government with jurisdiction, or the frontier companies jointly)

reach.1: a niche audience (under 1,000 likes or 100 Hacker News points; trade press)
reach.2: a wide audience in the field (1,000 to 10,000 likes, 100 to 500 points, national press)
reach.3: the general public (over 10,000 likes, over 500 points, or front-page coverage in several countries)

reasoning.2: an argument with evidence that can be checked
reasoning.3: a documented finding: data, a study, a legal text or a recorded event

corroboration.1: repeated by others who cite the same source
corroboration.3: confirmed by a primary document or by several independent sources

card_score: the sum of the five parts, 0 to 15; each part has a one-line reason and the card a quoted passage
two_passes: two scorers work without seeing each other; a card's score is the mean; a card is flagged when one part differs by 2 or more, the totals differ by 3 or more, or the scorers disagree on the side
events: cards about the same event form one event; an event's score is its highest card; a side's total is the sum of its events
cap: one actor counts for at most three events per side in a review, its highest

collection.window: from the frozen reading of 9 November 2026 to the day of the review; X search reaches back seven days only and is collected on a schedule
collection.symmetry: for each question and source type, the same number of queries per side from the same templates, and at most six cards per side; every query is logged with what it returned, including nothing
collection.inclusion: an item is carded when it states or does something about the question and names who; duplicates of one event are kept as cards of that event

proposal_rule.level question: a change of level is proposed to the owner when one side's total is at least 60% of both sides' in two consecutive reviews and that side has an event with directness 3 by an actor of power 3; otherwise 'no change' with the balance shown
proposal_rule.attitude question: no level is at stake; the balance (side A's share of both totals) is reported overall and per audience, as input to the effort rule

owner: approves or rejects a proposal and audits a random sample of five cards per question; does not accept or reject single items
conflict: the collector and scorers are AI models made by one of the frontier companies under assessment; quoted passages and part scores are kept so that every score can be checked
